clue.text: Jack is speaking when you are declared to be in power

indicators.note: to be in tells us the declared letters sit inside the jack-plus-is pair

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in a pack of cards

indicators.note: declared means spoken out, so the phrase is replaced by the letters that sound like it

parts.note: said out loud, the phrase sounds like the letters U and R, as in text-speak
diction is a manner of speaking, the way one articulates words

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a jack's speech is what announces your accession to office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is a link. 'declared' turns 'you are' into the two letters that sound like it, as in text-speak; 'to be in' places them inside the jack and 'is' pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Jurisdiction is the official authority to rule or judge, a form of legal control.

clue.text: Bloomer made by evangelist with old pen, it's said

indicators.note: it's said marks that the spoken sound of the earlier phrase gives the entry

parts.note: John is one of the four Gospel writers, and a quill is a pen of the old kind, made from a feather

explanation.surface: A howler was committed by a preacher writing with an antique quill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder but here means a flowering plant. JOHN + QUILL said out loud gives the flower's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A jonquil is a narcissus, a plant that blooms in spring, so it is a flowering thing.

clue.text: Regret being without regular income

indicators.note: being without here means standing outside, so the word for regret wraps around the other piece

parts.note: to rue something is to regret it
even means regular, steady, uniform

explanation.surface: Someone is sorry to find themselves with no steady earnings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but here means 'outside', as in the old hymn line 'a green hill far away, without a city wall'.
explanation.definitionFit: Revenue is the money taken in by a business or state, its earnings.

clue.text: Land vehicle brought in appears to prosper

indicators.note: brought in signals that the vehicle word is placed inside the word for land

parts.note: soil is land, earth or ground
a trike is a tricycle, a three-wheeled vehicle

explanation.surface: A vehicle being brought ashore seems to be doing well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appears to' is a link phrase. 'Land' looks like a verb but is the noun SOIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike oil is an idiom for suddenly becoming successful or rich, from finding a petroleum well.

clue.text: Bone preserved in formalin, customarily

indicators.note: preserved in suggests something kept within, so the letters sit inside the words formalin, customarily

explanation.surface: A bone kept in formaldehyde solution, as is usual in laboratories.
explanation.definitionFit: The incus, or anvil, is one of the three small bones of the middle ear.

clue.text: Ground to soak up water

indicators.note: in a down clue, up tells us to read the soaking word from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to ret flax or hemp is to soak it in water to soften it
rain is water falling from the sky

explanation.surface: Instructions for earth to absorb moisture.
explanation.walkthrough: To ret is a craft word: flax is soaked to loosen its fibres. 'up' turns that word backwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain is a stretch of land considered for its physical features, the lie of the land.

clue.text: Identity of somebody brought be fore the head

indicators.note: brought before says the first piece is placed ahead of the next one

parts.note: one means somebody, a person, as in 'one never knows'
a ness is a headland, a cape, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness

explanation.surface: Someone's identity is established after they are hauled up in front of the principal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' looks like a boss but is a headland, NESS. The clue prints 'be fore', a split of 'before'.
explanation.definitionFit: Oneness means sameness or unity, being one and the same thing.

clue.text: Rush forecast — get it wrong — it's in the blood

indicators.note: get it wrong signals that the letters of the two words are rearranged, not taken correctly

explanation.surface: A hasty weather prediction is made in error, which is just in someone's nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's in the blood' looks like a comment on character but literally defines a blood antigen.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhesus factor is an antigen carried on red blood cells, determining Rh-positive or negative blood groups.

clue.text: Duke not involved in surrender of royal house

indicators.note: not involved in tells us one letter is taken away from the longer word

parts.note: a handover is a surrender, a giving up of control

explanation.surface: A nobleman takes no part in the capitulation of a dynasty.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanover is the German dynasty that ruled Britain from George I to Victoria.

clue.text: Scoundrel demanding payment for present

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible person, a scoundrel
rent is a regular payment for the use of property

explanation.surface: A villain insists on cash for a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'demanding' is a link. 'present' looks like a gift but means existing now.
explanation.definitionFit: Current means of the present time, happening now, as in current affairs.

clue.text: Time to listen to chap in Eastern country

parts.note: to hear is to listen to
gent is short for gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: It is the moment to hear out a man in an Oriental land.
explanation.walkthrough: The Argentine is an old-fashioned name for Argentina, with the definite article.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina, formerly often called by this name, is a nation of South America.

clue.text: Family taking sheep around in Russian craft

indicators.note: around signals that the whole run is turned back to front

parts.note: kin are one's family, relatives
tups are rams, male sheep

explanation.surface: A family with a flock of rams aboard a Russian vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' is a link. KIN + TUPS run backwards gives the name.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the first artificial satellite, launched by the Soviet Union in 1957, a spacecraft.

clue.text: As Asian, I'm found in South- East, doubly so

indicators.note: found in says the first-person phrase sits inside the compass points

parts.note: SE is the abbreviation for south-east
I'm expanded is I am
doubly so means the compass abbreviation occurs a second time

explanation.surface: Someone from the Orient explains they live in South-East Asia, twice over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' is a link. 'doubly so' tells you the compass abbreviation appears twice: once round the first-person phrase and once more after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Siamese means from Siam, the former name of Thailand, a country in south-east Asia.

clue.text: Preserve pre-prepared envelope containing meal ticket

indicators.note: containing means the first item holds the second inside it

parts.note: an SAE is a stamped addressed envelope, readied in advance for a reply
LV stands for luncheon voucher, a British workplace meal ticket

explanation.surface: Keep a ready-addressed envelope that holds a dining coupon.
explanation.walkthrough: SAE is a stamped addressed envelope; LV a luncheon voucher, a British employee perk for buying lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Salve, as a verb, means to save or rescue, keeping something from loss.

clue.text: Manager of musician cut royalty

indicators.note: cut says the final letter is removed from the musician word

parts.note: an organist is a musician who plays the organ
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen, hence royalty

explanation.surface: A musician's manager reduced the performer's royalties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link. 'royalty' looks like a fee but is ER, the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: An organiser arranges and runs things, as a manager does.

clue.text: Fuel storage, most agree, needs repair

indicators.note: needs repair suggests the letters are broken and must be put back in a new order

explanation.surface: Most people concur that the gas tank needs fixing.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasometer is a large tank for holding town gas, a fuel.

clue.text: Cool Paris stirred up Greek stronghold

indicators.note: stirred up means mixed, so the letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A calm French capital was roused to unrest by a Greek citadel.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acropolis is the citadel of Athens, a fortified hilltop.

clue.text: Revolutionary type of tyre containing carbon

indicators.note: containing means the tyre word holds the chemical symbol inside it

parts.note: a radial is a radial-ply tyre
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A new kind of tyre with carbon in it is a breakthrough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' suggests a wheel turning, but it means extreme.
explanation.definitionFit: A radical is someone wanting sweeping political change, a revolutionary.

clue.text: Drunk individual taken in by policeman turning up, showing prudence

indicators.note: taken in by means the drunk-plus-individual pieces are put inside the reversed policeman
in a down clue, turning up means the word for policeman is read bottom to top

parts.note: cop is a slang word for a policeman
lit is slang for drunk
I is a Roman one, a single individual

explanation.surface: A drunkard arrested by an officer who arrives behaves sensibly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' makes POC from the slang word for an officer, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Politic means wise and judicious, acting with good sense.

clue.text: Gloomy working, not having university first

indicators.note: not having says the letter that follows is dropped from the working word

parts.note: usable means working, in a fit state to use

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word university

explanation.surface: Someone is downcast because their job came without a degree to start with.
explanation.definitionFit: Sable, as a literary adjective, means black, dark, so dismal or sombre.

clue.text: Weapon Japanese commander carries about finally

indicators.note: carries means the commander word holds the letter inside it

parts.note: a shogun was a hereditary military ruler of Japan

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word about

explanation.surface: A Japanese warlord carries a weapon around at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A shotgun is a smooth-bore gun firing pellets, a firearm.

clue.text: Toadstool, doubtless, is endlessly being disseminated

indicators.note: being disseminated means scattered, so the letters are spread into a new arrangement
endlessly drops the first and last letters of the word doubtless

explanation.surface: No doubt a fungus is spreading its spores without end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link. 'endlessly' turns 'doubtless' into OUBTLES, which 'being disseminated' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Boletus is a genus of fungi with pores under the cap, mushroom-like growths.

clue.text: Infant's stroller

definitions.meaning: a young child just learning to walk
one who walks unsteadily, taking short wobbly steps

explanation.walkthrough: 'stroller' suggests a pushchair, which an infant rides in, but here it is one who toddles.
explanation.definitionFit: A child aged about one to three is so called from the toddling way it walks.

clue.text: Occupies top position in Australian sport

definitions.meaning: to govern, reign, be in charge
Aussie ... football, played on an oval field

explanation.walkthrough: Australian rules is a football code played mainly in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who reigns over others is in charge; Aussie football is known simply by this plural name.

clue.text: Satellite came down to earth in nocturnal conditions

definitions.note: the defining phrase is adverbial, while the entry is an adjective describing such a scene

parts.note: the moon is Earth's natural satellite
lit means landed, came down, as a bird lights on a branch

explanation.surface: A space probe landed on the surface during the night.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonlit describes a scene illuminated by night by our satellite's glow.

clue.text: : Record Italian's musical performance

parts.note: rec is an abbreviation for record or recorded
Ital is an abbreviation for Italian

explanation.surface: A recording of an Italian's concert.
explanation.walkthrough: The leading colon is a printing artefact.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a concert given by a soloist or small group.

clue.text: Hear giant get wind up

indicators.note: Hear tells us to take the spoken sound of the word for giant

parts.note: a titan is a giant, one of the huge Greek deities

explanation.surface: Listen, the colossus is getting nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get' is a link. 'wind up' looks like being nervous but means to turn tighter, as a spring.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind up a spring or clock is to make it taut by turning.

clue.text: Girl bound to have succeeded in place down under

parts.note: Alice is a girl's name
a spring is a leap or bound
S is the abbreviation for succeeded, used in genealogies

explanation.surface: A girl leapt and won in the Australian outback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to have' is a link. 'down under' is Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Alice Springs is a town in Australia's Northern Territory.
